title.narrative: General Volunteer Project for Providing Training Courses for Technical Staff in Air Conditioning Systems Maintenance

description.narrative: Raise the efficiency of technical staff in the field of installing and operating air conditioning systems; provide young people with an additional opportunity to enter the labor market and expand their sources of income; provide support by preparing technicians capable of providing maintenance services for homes, schools, elderly care homes and others.

Training and qualifying technical staff to work in the installation and operation of air conditioning systems, contributing to qualifying young people for the labor market and opening new fields for employment or expansion in freelance work, especially in providing maintenance services for homes, schools, elderly care homes and other facilities.
